title: CRUIS'N USA / MIDWAY SINGLE SIT-DOWN

uncertainties: Selected original-design single sit-down is corroborated by the cabinet photograph, not assumed to be a factory-specific regional/restoration example. Compact twin/shared leader marquee and upright remain research-only variants.

The chrome controls photograph corroborates button functions/colors/positions, but its finish is not copied onto the selected black dashboard. Start and Radio plus three views are five modeled physical buttons; they are not five racing actions.

One photographed full-height side print is reused readably on the opposite side. The side's slanted silhouette is masked before extraction. No unseen print or seat-back decal is invented: the tall black seat uses modeled ribs.

The display is the actual same-game racing image rectified from the separate upright photograph, not a local capture. Only the gameplay image crosses variants; no upright shell or artwork is silently mixed in. Glare and source detail limit fidelity. A capture attempt with the supplied legacy ZIP under the parent crusnusa name failed MAME ROM validation (the supplied program is revision 4.1); no ROM was downloaded, modified or fabricated to work around it.

The tower/bucket/platform dimensions, shifter, seat ribs and service details are sprite-scale estimates. The shared racing shell is adapted with full-height side art and a taller seat. Footprint is compressed to 70% around the existing cell anchor; leave clearance at later placement.

Original decoded downloads, SHA-256 and dimensions are retained. Copyrighted Midway/Nintendo artwork and photograph rights remain unresolved; third-party archive access is not redistribution authorization.
